author: 鱼亦乐 (yuyile)
abstract: End-to-end short-film pipeline in the Archival Fragments visual style — ivory paper, monochrome print, one muted crimson accent. Turns an idea or a script into a finished film: installs and verifies dependencies (ffmpeg, LibTV CLI, Fish Audio), writes the script, breaks it into story / visuals / rhythm, designs a chained keyframe sequence, drives MiniMax H3 first-last-frame generation shot by shot, synthesizes narration, and assembles with ffmpeg. Enforces three hard constraints: every shot needs a distinct keyframe, the shot table must be reviewed before generation, and concrete universal symbols beat abstract graphics. Validated on a 67.3s / 34-shot film, all shots first-pass.
